notes.title: Blue Fish Yokohoma - Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Blue Fish Yokohama - Patch 1.1 [/b][/h3]

First update to the game :)

Changes:
[list]
[*] It's now possible to unlock levels in numerical sequence
[*] Update to level 3
[*] Changed initial song
[*] Added blue fish icon to the .exe
[*] Bug fixes 
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
